sn12.93-103:1.1: Jarāmaraṇaṃ bhikkhave ajānatā apassatā yathābhūtaṃ jarāmaraṇe yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāya sikkhā karaṇīya || Evam
sn12.203-213:2.0: Tassuddānam || || Satthā Sikkhā ca Yogo ca || Chando Ussoḷhī pañcamī Appativānī Ātappaṃ || Viriyaṃ Sātaccaṃ vuccati || Sati ca Sampajaññañca || Appamādena dvādasāti || || Suttantā antarapeyyālā niṭṭhitā || ||
sn12.203-213:3.1: Pare te dvādasa honti || suttā dvattiṃsasatāni || Catusaccena te vuttā || peyyāla-antaramhi ye || Antarapeyyāle hi uddānaṃ samattaṃ || ||
